VHAPG Part 813.106 Simplified Acquisition Procedures: Soliciting from a Single Source Attachment 1: Single Source Justification for MPT up to SAT Revision: 02 Acquisition ID#

DEPARTMENT OF VETERANS AFFAIRS

Justification for Single Source Awards IAW FAR 13.106-1 For Over Micro-Purchase Threshold but Not Exceeding the Simplified Acquisition Threshold Acquisition Plan Action ID:36C261-26-AP-3525

1. Contracting Activity: Department of Veterans Affairs, VISN 21, NCO 21, VAPAHCS, VA Livermore Medical Center. 2237: 640-26-3-5281-0105

JOFOC:

2. Brief Description of Supplies/ Services required and the intended use/Estimated Amount:

The VA Livermore Clinic’s blowdown lines are leaking and need to be replaced. The hot water and steam are escaping, which is a safety concern.

The requested services to repair the boiler plant lines is as follows:

The Contractor shall provide all labor, materials, equipment, supervision, administrative support required for the repair to: remove and replace the main blowdown and surface blowdown manifolds and 2” Schedule 80 in the trench connecting to (3) boilers in Building 7 at the at VAPAHCS Livermore Division.

The estimated values is $22,600.00.

3. Unique characteristics that limit availability to only one source, with the reason no other supplies or services can be used:

The repairs to the boiler plant lines has been requested to be completed in a timing manner as there is an urgent need to avoid safety concerns and additional damage to the facility.

4. Description of market research conducted and results or statement why it was not conducted:

Due to the urgency of the requirement, minimal market research was conducted.

VHAPG Part 813.106 Simplified Acquisition Procedures: Soliciting from a Single Source Attachment 1: Single Source Justification for MPT up to SAT Revision: 02 Acquisition ID#

5. Contracting Officer's Certification: Purchase is approved in accordance with FAR 13.106-1(b). I certify that the foregoing justification is accurate and complete to the best of my knowledge and belief.

____________________________ ________________________ Jessica Newman Date Contracting Officer Network Contracting Office (NCO) 21 Construction Team 1
